info.title: Custom Search API - add OAuth2 security scheme

actions.description: Remove any existing (empty) securitySchemes so the set below is deterministic/idempotent.

Declare OAuth2 security schemes. The source Discovery doc ($discovery/rest?version=v1) carries no auth block, so the generated spec had an empty securitySchemes and Jentic One could not resolve authUrl/tokenUrl. The cse.list REST reference requires OAuth scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cse.

scopes.https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cse: Search over a website or collection of websites
Search over a website or collection of websites

actions.description: Remove any existing top-level security so the set below is deterministic/idempotent.
Require the OAuth2 scheme globally so Jentic One binds credentials (authUrl/tokenUrl) instead of falling back to a broken default.
